subject: [hw] DONE V15: T32 32-bit data processing
body:
V15 is complete and host-tested (no phone, nothing published).

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V15 PASS 1596/1596
(printed twice: clang -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all, then -O2 without sanitizers; ~5 s, builds only under /tmp/n2hw-V15.)

Implemented in gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_dp.c (all four regions of the class, masks posted to V02 and matching its t32_route):
- 0xEA00-0xEBFF: AND BIC ORR ORN EOR MOV MVN TST TEQ ADD ADC SBC SUB RSB CMN CMP with LSL/LSR/ASR/ROR/RRX immediate shifts and the plain register forms; PKHBT PKHTB. The TST/TEQ/CMN/CMP aliases (Rd=1111 with S) and MOV/MVN (Rn=1111) are the only r15 forms and never write r15.
- Modified immediate (0xF000-0xF1FF, 0xF400-0xF5FF with hw2 bit15=0): same ops minus PKH; ThumbExpandImm_C with all four replicated-byte cases and the rotated case.
- Plain binary immediate (0xF2/F3/F6/F7, hw2 bit15=0): ADDW SUBW ADR MOVW MOVT SSAT SSAT16 USAT USAT16 SBFX UBFX BFI BFC.
- 0xFA00-0xFAFF: LSL/LSR/ASR/ROR by register (with S), SXTB SXTH UXTB UXTH SXTB16 UXTB16 + the six accumulating forms with all rotations, REV REV16 REVSH RBIT CLZ SEL, all 36 parallel add/sub (S/Q/SH/U/UQ/UH x ADD8/ADD16/ASX/SUB8/SUB16/SAX) with GE flags, QADD QSUB QDADD QDSUB.
- 0xFB00-0xFBFF: MUL MLA MLS, SMULL UMULL SMLAL UMLAL UMAAL, SDIV UDIV, SMULxy SMLAxy SMULW<y> SMLAW<y> SMLALxy SMUAD(X) SMUSD(X) SMLAD(X) SMLSD(X) SMLALD(X) SMLSLD(X) SMMUL(R) SMMLA(R) SMMLS(R) USAD8 USADA8.
Semantics: AddWithCarry, Shift_C with clamping/ROR-mod-32/RRX, the shifter carry as ADC/SBC carry-in, sticky Q, GE from the parallel ops, SEL from GE.

Tests (all encodings via llvm-mc from vectors.s, read back from the object so the ADR fixups are resolved; no hand-typed instruction hex):
- 263 encodings, 1596 checks with literals from the ARM ARM: flag edges (carry out, overflow, zero, negative), shift amounts 0/1/31/32/33, RRX with C=0/1, all four rotations of every extend, SP as ADD/SUB operand, r15 in ADR and the compare/MOV aliases, saturation boundaries, sticky Q, divide by zero, INT_MIN/-1, UMAAL carries, ADC/SBC shifter-carry-in.
- 19 must-be-UNDEF encodings derived from assembled vectors by field mutation.
- 200000-word sweep (half drawn from my regions, half uniform random) under ASan/UBSan: every call OK or UNDEF and the PC state untouched.
- Decode coverage cross-checked against llvm-objdump over ~4000 structured words covering every op/shift/register/immediate form: the only llvm-decodable words I reject are the three UNPREDICTABLE ones (SBFX/UBFX lsb+width>32, BFI msb<lsb).
- Portability compile clean for arm64-apple-ios16.0 (Mach-O arm64), aarch64-linux-gnu and armv7a (freestanding headers; there is no iOS SDK on this host, so this is a compile check, not an iOS build).
- Census: hw-d01 reports 32166 reachable instructions / 91 mnemonics for V15 in the five vendor objects; all 91 are implemented, so no used mnemonic returns UNDEF.

Not done / open:
- Not run on the phone and not yet run under the real core (V02 t32_route already matches my masks; the T32 integration path is untested by me).
- ADC/SBC with modified immediate are implemented but cannot be assembled by llvm-mc (only decoded), so untested; the vendor set cannot contain them.
- PKHTB with a zero shift field is implemented as ASR #32 (llvm-objdump reads it that way; the assembler canonicalises to PKHBT instead).
- Parallel add/sub GE semantics for the halving/saturating variants are from my reading of the ARM ARM; no vendor code uses those instructions, so unverifiable against real code.
- No T01 differential kernel for V15 yet: a T32 kernel needs the core + V16 T32 branches/load-store before it can execute; deferred and noted to T01.

Files (mine only): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_dp.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/{run_tests.sh,gen_enc.py,vectors.s,t_dp.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V15/STATUS.md. Not committed (workers do not touch git history).
